newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline easier despite strong U.S demand.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline easier despite strong U.S demand.

text.p: NWE gasoline slipped on Tuesday as material struggled to find homes because of slow European demand and the difficulty of shipping product to the strong U.S. market.
Traders said vessels to take material transatlantic to take advantage of good U.S. demand were scarce and those market players able to find ships were paying up to $16 a tonne and more for freight.
Four tankers with cargoes ranging between 29-35,000 tonnes and loading between Jan 13-20 were reported chartered on Tuesday for transatlantic trips, shipbrokers said.
Activity in Europe was also being hampered by ice making barge movements difficult.
Eurograde barge prices eased during the course of the day from $224 fob AR done in the morning and $219 heard concluded in the afternoon.
NYMEX gasoline was easier for much of the day, but retraced losses by late on the afternoon at 72.60 cents a gallon. Strong U.S. refiner buying has helped prices surge.
